fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-d74cf4df at b13f7976 (attempt 2, fixing review finding f1): go test -count=1 -v ./internal/tui/inboxapp passed all 24 tests with a fake runner: TestRowPerItemInOrder (a row per item in order); TestEnterOpensActionPerKind now asserts the action view opens in the app for question (answer form), signoff (Sign off dialog), failed (Retry/Abandon), accept (Accept this change set? confirm) and open/gate (one answer field per open question), with no Open hook left; TestAcceptConfirmedCallsAccept/TestAcceptDeclinedCallsNothing and TestGateAnswersEachThenResumes/TestGateBlankAnswerSendsNothing drive accept and question.answer+run.resume through the runner; TestActionFor maps stalled, overlap, disk-low, usage-reserve and main-stale to show, and TestOtherKindShowsDetailAndOpensTab shows the stalled detail and calls inbox.open; TestEmptyInbox shows one empty-state line. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(tui-inbox-app|inbox-open)$ passed: tui-inbox-app cmps rhiza tui app inbox --once with rhiza inbox --json. Read the diff: cmd/rhiza/tui.go now routes accept with the change set as write target, so the shipped app acts on gate and accept items.
